verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence of an interactive API reference with runnable examples. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404. The claim that GlitchTip "aims to be Sentry API compatible" is adjacent: it is not a first-party explorable reference. The CLI and MCP docs cover other stories and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
